battle.name: 森巴戰爭
battle.brief: 一八四一年五月，錫克帝國屬下森巴（多格拉）將領左拉瓦爾·辛格以朝拜為名，率七千餘人分三路入阿里；藏軍封馬攸木山口、奪回補仁宗，十二月於瑪旁雍錯南岸雪中設伏，斬左拉瓦爾。卡面雷管步槍是一八四〇年法國的後膛新槍，此戰線上並未出現，交鋒靠火繩槍、長矛與劈山砲。最後以楚舒爾條約劃界收場。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是清朝的西藏地方與中央派駐的駐藏大臣、幫辦大臣，一方是錫克帝國的屬藩查謨與克什米爾（多格拉王國）境內的森巴部落。西藏方面的指揮系統是清廷的理藩與駐藏體系：駐藏大臣孟保與幫辦大臣海樸在拉薩坐鎮，發令「進兵攻剿，痛加懲創」，兵馬由噶廈調派，噶倫索康·才旦多吉與團長戴琫（比喜）各率兵團馳援阿里，阿里與後藏之間的防務則依馬攸木山口一線佈置。森巴方面的指揮系統是部落式的：然吉森、索熱森、谷朗森三大部落之中，實力最強的索熱森出精兵，主帥是查謨總督古拉卜·辛格麾下的將領左拉瓦爾·辛格·卡魯利亞，他於一八三四年、一八四〇年兩度攻入拉達克，一八四一年再越境入阿里；拉達克國王與巴勒提的部眾隨其作戰，錫克帝國本土另派援軍但未越境。第三方是英屬印度：東印度公司支持森巴以抗衡錫克勢力，同時也想打破拉達克對西藏羊绒的獨家壟斷，一八四二年英方以孟買總督致信拉合爾宮廷的壓力促成撤軍；尼泊爾則在旁觀望，並曾派使團到左拉瓦爾處交涉。
countriesEn: On one side stood Tibet under Qing rule, with the imperial residents in Lhasa, and on the other the Semba tribes of the Dogra kingdom of Jammu and Kashmir, a feudatory of the Sikh Empire. The Tibetan command system was the Qing administration of Tibet: the amban Mengbao and the assistant amban Haipu sat in Lhasa and ordered the troops to advance and punish sharply, the men being drawn by the Kashag, with the cabinet minister Surkhang Tsetan and the regiment commander Dai Duan, styled Bikhi, each leading a body of troops to Ngari, and the defence of the line between Ngari and U-Tsang resting on the Mayum La pass. The command system of the Semba was tribal: of the three great branches, Ranjit Sen, Sor Sen and Gulang Sen, the strongest, Sor Sen, supplied the pick of the force, and the commander was Zorawar Singh Kahluria, a general of Gulab Singh's at Jammu, who invaded Ladakh in 1834 and again at the end of 1840 and crossed into Ngari in 1841; the Ladakhi king and the Balti clans fought with him, and the Sikh Empire sent reinforcements of its own without crossing the border. The third party was British India: the East India Company had backed the Semba against the Sikh power and also wanted a share of the pashmina trade, and in 1842 pressure carried in a letter from the governor of Bombay to the Lahore durbar helped bring about the withdrawal; Nepal watched from the side and sent a mission to Zorawar Singh after the conquest of Taklakot.
people: 左拉瓦爾·辛格是這場戰爭的樞紐，也是它的破綻。他是古拉卜·辛格手下的多格拉將領，性好擴張，一八三四年率兵吞併拉達克，一八三六年在Jandiala Sher Khan向蘭吉特·辛格請求出兵西藏遭拒，一八三九年蘭吉特·辛格病故後阻力減弱，一八四〇年末再取拉達克，一八四一年五月以朝拜岡仁波齊與羊卓雍錯為名率七千餘人越境。統率上他分三路：一路經魯普舒與哈尼勒，一路沿印度河谷趨扎西崗，一路沿朋池錯趨熱沃克，他自領第三路，奪熱沃克後南下會師，攻取噶爾托克與札拉果德。西藏方面的關鍵人物是駐藏大臣孟保與幫辦大臣海樸，兵權在噶廈，噶倫索康·才旦多吉與團長戴琫（比喜）領兵反攻，另有噶倫久美·策旺班覺與夏扎·旺曲杰布參贊。十二月的伏擊裡，左拉瓦爾中彈受傷仍持刀搏鬥，最後被藏軍士兵斬首，拉達克一側則流傳他死於一發金彈。幕後的英方人物是孟買總督與加爾各答的印度總督府，錫克方面的關鍵人物是古拉卜·辛格及其姪賈瓦希爾·辛格，後者於一八四二年率援軍在楚舒爾擊敗藏軍。
peopleEn: Zorawar Singh was the pivot of this war and also its weak point. A Dogra general under Gulab Singh, he was driven by appetite for expansion: he took Ladakh in 1834, was refused permission to invade Tibet at Jandiala Sher Khan in 1836, and after Ranjit Singh's death in 1839 met less obstruction, taking Ladakh again at the end of 1840 and crossing the frontier in May 1841 under the pretext of pilgrimage to Kailash and Lake Yamtso. He split his force three ways: one column through Rupshu and Hanle, one down the Indus valley towards Tashigang, and one along Pangong Tso towards Rudok, the last under his own command, and after taking Rudok he moved south, joined the other columns and attacked Gartok and Taklakot. On the Tibetan side the key men were the amban Mengbao and the assistant amban Haipu, with the military power in the Kashag, and the cabinet minister Surkhang Tsetan and the regiment commander Dai Duan (Bikhi) leading the counter-stroke, assisted by the ministers Gyume Tsewang Paljor and the Shasa. In the December ambush Zorawar Singh was wounded and kept fighting with a sword before being beheaded by Tibetan soldiers, while the Ladakhi account says he was killed by a golden bullet. Behind the scenes sat the governor of Bombay and the government of India at Calcutta; on the Sikh side the key figures were Gulab Singh and his nephew Jawahir Singh, who brought up reinforcements and beat the Tibetan army at Chushul in 1842.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍在這條戰線上並沒有出現。雷管底火是一八二〇年代才有的發明，擊錘打擊火帽即可起火，不受風雪與潮氣影響，一八四〇年法國列裝的步槍正是以它取代火燧，成為新一代線列步槍；但西藏的武庫裡沒有這種槍，阿里與拉達克的士兵用的是火繩槍，藏軍的火繩在高原的寒冷與乾燥裡常常打不著，槍身又沒有刺刀可用；駐藏大臣從拉薩武庫取出兩門劈山砲交給藏軍，用以攻打森巴在多湯地方新築的碉樓，這是全戰最重的火器。森巴與多格拉一方的裝備同樣老舊：火繩步槍、長矛、刀與小盾，配合錫克帝國本土軍隊使用的沙爾巴洛夫火燧步槍；他們沒有成建制的炮兵，只有零星小砲。運輸全靠馱畜：犛牛、綿羊與馬匹翻越海拔四千五百公尺以上的山口，補給線一斷，前線立刻失去彈藥與糧食。真正起決定作用的不是任何一支近代火槍，而是封山口、雪中伏擊與距離。卡面這件步槍代表的是同年正推入歐洲戰場的新一代火器，它在西藏高原上只以想像的方式存在。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card never appeared on this front. The percussion cap was an invention of the 1820s: a hammer struck a small cap and the powder ignited, indifferent to wind, snow and damp, and the musket the French adopted in 1840 replaced the flintlock with it to become the new generation of line musket. The Tibetan arsenals had no such weapon. The soldiers of Ngari and Ladakh carried matchlocks, the match often failed to light in the cold and dry air of the plateau, and the barrels had no bayonets; the amban took two splitting-mountains guns from the arsenal at Lhasa and gave them to the Tibetan troops to work on the forts the Semba had newly raised at Dotang, and those two pieces were the heaviest firearms in the war. The equipment of the Semba and Dogra side was equally archaic: matchlocks, spears, knives and small shields, supported by the sarbaloof flintlock muskets of the Punjabi Sikh troops; they had no formed artillery, only a few small pieces. Everything moved on pack animals, yaks, sheep and horses, over passes above four thousand five hundred metres, and when the supply line broke the front lost its ammunition and its food at once. What decided the war was not any modern firearm but the closing of a pass, an ambush in snow and distance. The rifle on the card stands for the new generation of small arms entering the European battlefields in the very same year; on the Tibetan plateau it existed only in the imagination.
tactics: 三路入侵本身就是戰術：分兵沿不同山口同時入藏，北路由左拉瓦爾自領，沿班公錯東進趨日土宗，以防新疆方向來援，中路由諾諾色朗溯獅泉河而上，南路由塔那達日沿象泉河推進，三路在噶爾宗會師後南下洗劫補仁宗。藏軍的反制分兩步：第一步是封路，把馬攸木山口封住，切斷森巴軍進入後藏的捷徑，逼迫對方回頭；同時收復補仁宗與噶爾凍，再用從拉薩武庫取出的劈山砲攻多湯一帶的碉樓。第二步是雪中設伏：藏軍選在大雪之後在瑪旁雍錯南岸佈下埋伏，中央故意留出一條通路讓敵軍推進，待其三個縱隊走入，再四面合擊，斬其主帥，俘拉達克大臣二人、森巴頭目四十餘人、士卒七百餘人。追擊至列城附近的頓姆熱時藏軍反被森巴軍擊敗，說明藏軍的優勢只在熟悉地形與掌握主動的一方。收尾靠的是條約而非戰役：一八四二年九月十七日在列城以交換照會的方式達成協議，劃定拉達克與古格、普蘭的邊界，維持舊界與舊例。
tacticsEn: The three-column invasion was itself the method: the force entered Tibet by different passes at the same time, the northern column under Zorawar Singh moving east along Lake Pangong towards Ritagong to cover the approach of reinforcements from Xinjiang, the middle column under Nonotserang up the Lion Spring river, and the southern under Tanadari along the Elephant Spring river, the three meeting at Garzong and then pushing south to strip Purangzong. The Tibetan counter-stroke had two stages. The first was to close the road: they sealed the Mayum La pass to cut the short route by which the Semba could reach U-Tsang, forcing the enemy to turn back, while recovering Purangzong and Garldong and bringing the two splitting-mountains guns from the Lhasa arsenal against the newly built forts at Dotang. The second stage was the ambush in snow: after a heavy fall the Tibetans lay in wait on the southern shore of Lake Manasarovar, deliberately leaving a road open through the middle of their line so that the enemy would advance into it, and when the invaders came on in three units with flags and drums they were attacked from every side, the commander was killed, two Ladakhi ministers, more than forty Semba chiefs and over seven hundred soldiers were taken. Pursuing the broken enemy to Dumra, a day's march from Leh, the Tibetans were themselves beaten, which shows that their advantage belonged to the side that knew the ground and held the initiative. The war was closed by a treaty rather than by a battle: on 17 September 1842 an exchange of notes at Leh fixed the frontier between Ladakh and Guge and Purang, confirming the old line and the old custom.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但各方記載互有出入。條目所列兵力，錫克—森巴方約一萬五千人，藏軍方約四千；英文資料另記左拉瓦爾出兵時實帶四千兵眾，由拉達克人、巴勒提人與基什瓦爾人及多格拉核心組成，藏方則估為六千人，兵源與番號並不統一，可見幾種說法各有依據。戰役過程中的確數：左拉瓦爾一八四一年五月出兵，兵逾七千，分三路；十一月藏軍在札拉果德方向得手，據稱新增援軍約一萬人；十二月十四日的伏擊中，約三百名多格拉士兵戰死，約七百人被俘；藏軍俘拉達克大臣二人、森巴頭目四十餘人、士卒七百餘人。條目另記一八四一年英方陣亡六百五十人，藏蒙軍方陣亡六千八百人、被俘八百人後遭斬首——這組數字與其餘記載明顯不合，引用時必須保留其存疑。地理數字：馬攸木山口海拔約五千一百公尺，列城約三千五百公尺，瑪旁雍錯約四千五百公尺，阿里至列城約三百公里。一八四二年九月十七日楚舒爾條約簽訂；一八四六年查謨與克什米爾成為英屬印度的土邦。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, and the accounts disagree with one another. The strength given in the reference lists is about fifteen thousand men for the Sikh and Semba side and about four thousand for the Tibetans; the English material records that Zorawar Singh actually marched with four thousand men drawn from Ladakhis, Baltis and Kishtwaris with a Dogra core, while the Tibetan estimate was six thousand, and since the composition and the regimental names are not uniform, several versions each have something behind them. The firmer numbers from the course of the fighting: Zorawar Singh set out in May 1841 with more than seven thousand men in three columns; in November the Tibetans recovered ground towards Taklakot and are said to have brought up about ten thousand reinforcements; in the ambush of 14 December about three hundred Dogra soldiers were killed and about seven hundred taken; the Tibetans captured two Ladakhi ministers, more than forty Semba chiefs and over seven hundred soldiers. The same reference list also gives six hundred and fifty dead on the Sikh side and six thousand eight hundred Tibetan and Mongol dead with eight hundred captured and afterwards beheaded, figures which plainly do not fit the rest of the record and must be quoted with that reservation. On geography: the Mayum La pass stands at about five thousand one hundred metres, Leh at about three thousand five hundred, Lake Manasarovar at about four thousand five hundred, and the distance from Ngari to Leh is about three hundred kilometres. The Treaty of Chushul was signed on 17 September 1842, and in 1846 Jammu and Kashmir became a princely state under British India.
cause: 起因是拉達克的宗主權與羊绒生意的爭奪。第一層是商路：一六八四年《廷莫斯甘條約》把西藏羊绒的獨家接收權給了拉達克，克什米爾的披肩工業因此有了原料；多格拉吞併拉達克打破了這條獨占，東印度公司也把注意力轉向經布沙爾進入西藏的羊绒生意，於是三方各有算盤。第二層是邊界與牧場：拉達克王國在阿里與古格一線本有歷史性的權利主張，森巴人援引《廷莫斯甘條約》以前的舊例，聲稱領有馬攸山口以西之地；一八三四年左拉瓦爾首度攻入拉達克，拉達克王被迫稱臣納貢，一八四〇年末左拉瓦爾以拉達克爽約為由再度出兵，佔領列城並吞併全境。第三層是清廷的處境：道光年間清廷正忙於鴉片戰爭而無暇西顧，駐藏大臣在拉達克告急時竟不發兵救援，給了森巴可乘之機；一八四一年五月左拉瓦爾判定西藏阿里守軍僅數百人且距拉達克較近，遂定下先取阿里的計畫。第四層是英國的作用：東印度公司自一八三〇年代起支持森巴對抗錫克勢力，使森巴得以擺脫錫克控制，間接養壯了這支往西擴張的力量。
causeEn: The cause was the contest over suzerainty over Ladakh and over the pashmina trade. The first layer was commerce: the Treaty of Tingmosgang of 1684 gave Ladakh the exclusive right to receive the pashmina wool of Tibet, on which the Kashmir shawl industry depended; the Dogra annexation of Ladakh broke that monopoly, and the East India Company turned its attention to the pashmina road through Bushahr, so that all three parties had a calculation. The second layer was frontier and pasture: Ladakh had historic claims towards Ngari and Guge, and the Semba invoked the usage that preceded the Treaty of Tingmosgang to claim everything west of the Mayum pass; in 1834 Zorawar Singh first entered Ladakh and the king was forced to acknowledge suzerainty and pay tribute, and at the end of 1840 Zorawar Singh marched again on the ground that Ladakh had defaulted, took Leh and absorbed the whole kingdom. The third layer was the condition of the Qing court: in the Daoguang years the empire was absorbed by the Opium War and could not look west, and when Ladakh called for help the amban sent no troops, which gave the Semba its opening; in May 1841 Zorawar Singh judged that the Tibetan garrison in Ngari numbered only a few hundred and lay nearer to Ladakh, and settled on taking Ali first. The fourth layer was the British hand: from the 1830s the East India Company had supported the Semba against the Sikh power, which let the Semba slip free of Sikh control and in effect nursed the force that was now pushing west.
impact: 後果有四層。第一層是西藏的邊界：楚舒爾條約確認拉達克已被併入錫克帝國，並放棄拉達克對西藏西部的舊有領土要求，於是阿里與後藏之間的實際控制線被固定下來，拉達克王保留在本地居住，兩年一度的羅布恰克使團仍可入拉薩，貿易照舊例進行。第二層是查謨與克什米爾的命運：一八四六年英國以條約把查謨與克什米爾置於英屬印度的宗主权之下，森巴君主古拉卜·辛格成為第一任土邦大君，拉達克從此成為英屬印度的一部分；此後一八七九年英國在阿富汗的失敗、中俄在帕米爾的角力，以及二十世紀的邊界爭議，都以這條線為起點。第三層是俘虜與族群：一八四一年被俘的錫克與多格拉士兵留在西藏，與當地女子成家，後代散居拉薩一帶，引入葡萄、桃與杏，達賴喇嘛的肉案傳統中留下他們的名號；一八五六年《塔帕塔利條約》第四條釋放了仍在西藏的戰俘，一百零六人被集結於加德滿都，其中五十六人選擇回印度並獲銀章紀念。第四層是史觀的分歧：一九六〇年代中印邊界爭議中，印度方面以條約中「古已有之的界線」一語，證明拉達克與西藏的邊界曾經劃定；中方則認為即使劃定，也沒有保證與今日所主張的一線相同。這場一八四二年的交換照會，就此變成一段仍在使用的古老證詞。
impactEn: The consequences came in four layers. The first was the frontier of Tibet: the Treaty of Chushul confirmed that Ladakh had been annexed to the Sikh Empire and abandoned Ladakh's old claims on western Tibet, so that the line of effective control between Ngari and U-Tsang was fixed, the Ladakhi king was allowed to live on his own territory, the biennial Lopchak missions still went to Lhasa, and trade went on as the old custom prescribed. The second was the future of Jammu and Kashmir: in 1846 Britain brought the state under its own paramountcy and the Semba ruler Gulab Singh became its first Maharaja, with Ladakh now part of British India; the British failure in Afghanistan in 1879, the Anglo-Russian contest in the Pamirs and the frontier disputes of the twentieth century all begin from that line. The third was the prisoners and the communities they left behind: the Sikh and Dogra soldiers captured in 1841 stayed in Tibet, married local women, and their descendants settled around Lhasa, bringing grapes, peaches and apricots with them, and the butchers of the later Dalai Lamas kept their name; the fourth article of the Treaty of Thapathali of 1856 released the prisoners still held in Tibet, a hundred and six of them were mustered at Kathmandu, and fifty-six chose to return to India and were each given a silver medal. The fourth was historiography: in the border dispute of the 1960s India used the phrase about the old established frontiers to show that the line between Ladakh and Tibet had once been delimited, while China argued that even a delimitation guarantees nothing about where the present claim lies. That exchange of notes of 1842 has become an ancient piece of evidence still in use.
result: 結果是一場誰也沒能全得的交換。左拉瓦爾在一八四一年十二月戰死，森巴軍潰逃回列城，藏軍收復補仁宗、噶爾凍與阿里南部各宗，俘虜七百餘人；但藏軍追擊至列城附近的頓姆熱時反被森巴軍擊敗，攻入拉達克的路線就此作罷。此後錫克帝國在英方壓力下於一八四一年十二月十日限期撤軍，多格拉軍隊乘勢攻入拉達克，藏軍節節退到楚舒爾，一八四二年八月在楚舒爾被多格拉軍擊敗，藏軍主將陣亡。最後的收場是一八四二年九月十七日在列城簽訂的楚舒爾條約，以交換照會的方式執行：藏方承認拉達克併入錫克帝國，錫克方放棄拉達克對西藏西部的舊有主張，雙方各守疆界，使團例制與商路照舊，貿易依古已有之的習慣進行，戰爭至此結束，雙方都沒有佔有對方的土地。這場戰爭的真正意義不在勝負，而在於它把一段模糊的高原邊界，變成了一份雙方簽字、日後仍可援引的文件。
resultEn: The result was an exchange in which neither side could take everything. Zorawar Singh was killed in December 1841, the Semba army broke and fled back towards Leh, the Tibetans recovered Purangzong, Garldong and the southern districts of Ngari and took more than seven hundred prisoners; but when they pursued the broken enemy to Dumra, a day's march from Leh, they were beaten in turn, and the road into Ladakh was closed. Under British pressure the Sikh Empire set a deadline of 10 December 1841 for the withdrawal, Dogra columns took advantage of it to advance into Ladakh, the Tibetans were driven back step by step to Chushul, and in August 1842 they were defeated there, the Tibetan commander falling in the battle. The end came with the Treaty of Chushul, signed at Leh on 17 September 1842 and executed by an exchange of notes: Tibet recognised that Ladakh had been annexed to the Sikh Empire, the Sikh Empire renounced the ancient Ladakhi claim on western Tibet, each side stayed within its own territory, the old missions and the old trade route continued, and trade was to be conducted according to old established custom. The war ended with neither side holding the other's land, and its real significance lies not in the fighting but in the fact that a vague frontier on the plateau was turned into a document signed on both sides, and capable of being cited long afterwards.
